en.headline: Hong Kong earmarks HK$50 million for Nepal-Tibet mudslide victims
en.dek: Chief Executive John Lee said the Disaster Relief Fund Advisory Committee will handle applications swiftly after deadly flash floods along the Himalayan border.
body: The Hong Kong government has set aside HK$50 million from the Disaster Relief Fund to support emergency aid for communities affected by catastrophic mudslides near Nepal’s border with Tibet’s Gyirong county.

Chief Executive John Lee Ka-chiu announced the allocation in a social-media post on Saturday. He expressed deep condolences to the victims and sympathy to those affected and their families, and thanked frontline rescuers working under secondary-disaster risks.
Lee said the Disaster Relief Fund Advisory Committee would process funding applications promptly so that timely support can reach the affected areas.

zh.headline: 李家超：賑災基金預留5,000萬元支援尼中泥石流災區
zh.dek: 行政長官對遇難者表示沉痛哀悼，賑災基金諮詢委員會將迅速處理撥款申請。
body: 行政長官李家超今日在社交平台表示，因尼泊爾一側發生泥石流災害，造成西藏日喀則市吉隆縣吉隆口岸重大人命傷亡及失聯，特區政府已從賑災基金預留5,000萬港元，作為緊急賑災項目之用。
李家超對遇難者表示沉痛哀悼，對受災者和遇難者家屬致以深切慰問，並衷心感謝所有前線救援人員不畏次生災害風險投入搶險工作。
他表示，賑災基金諮詢委員會將迅速處理撥款申請，祝願救災行動順利、平安，災民獲得及時支援。
